title: Codebase research for subreport detail rows design
body:
Completed codebase research for subreport detail rows feature. Key findings:

1. ResultSet (result-set.ts:38-42) is homogeneous — single columns array, rows as Record<string,unknown>[]. _row_type marker column (0=detail, 1=subtotal, 2=spacer, 3=grand total).

2. Engine (engine.ts:45-86) runTotalsMode is the stitching pattern to follow — builds detail query separately, executes totals query, pads columns with null, combines in JS. This is exactly the pattern detail bands will use.

3. Query plan (query-plan.ts:229-260) has a clean switch dispatch on aggMode. Adding a new execution mode (runDetailBandsMode) is minimally invasive — just add a case or post-processing step.

4. Subtotals (sql-subtotals.ts:67-250) uses UNION ALL with _row_type tagging — this is the reference pattern for band tagging, but detail bands can't use UNION ALL because different tables have different column sets.

5. Column catalog (column-catalog.ts:106-217) uses tablePrefix() for collision handling with lookup columns. Same pattern should be used for band columns.

6. State serializer (state-serializer.ts:25-80) and hydrator (state-hydrator.ts:29-335) have parallel structures — every new state field needs both. STATE_VERSION = 1 currently.

7. Pipeline card (pipeline-card.tsx) composes stages linearly: BaseStage → StackSheets → PipelineArrow → LookupStage[] → PipelineArrow → CalcStageSection[]. DetailBandStage fits after calc stages.

8. LookupStage (lookup-stage.tsx:47-321) is the template — 275 lines with table picker, key pair config, column chips, enable/disable, remove. DetailBandStage will be structurally similar but with: table picker, key pair config (parent→child), column picker, mode toggle (stack vs multi-band).

9. Export (export.ts:161-351) has row-kind-aware styling via _row_type. Band header rows will need a new row kind or _band_id-based styling.

10. Validation (validation.ts:151-606) validates every pipeline item. Detail bands need validation for: table exists, key pairs valid, columns available.

11. Report output (report-output.ts:46-53) createResultTable filters _row_type != 0. Band rows with _row_type=0 but _band_id set will pass through — this is correct for v1.

12. AG Grid (grid.tsx:82-164) renders all rows uniformly. Superset-column approach means many nulls for band-specific columns. Need to evaluate UX impact.

Guiding principle confirmed: model detail bands on lookups. Same state shape (array of specs), same colMap pattern (band prefix), same validation pattern, same serialization pattern.

title: Decision: separate _band_id column over extending _row_type
body:
Chose _band_id as a separate column over extending _row_type for detail band row typing.

Rationale: _row_type has 6 existing consumers (export.ts rowKinds, grid.tsx cellRenderer, report-output.ts createResultTable filter, styleExportSheet, applyExportMerges, and the subtotals SQL generator). Adding new _row_type values (4=band header, 5=band detail) would require updating all 6 consumers simultaneously — high risk of regression.

A separate _band_id column (null for parent rows, string ID for band rows) is additive — existing consumers ignore unknown columns. Band-aware consumers can opt in by checking _band_id.

Trade-off: two discriminator columns instead of one. Acceptable because _row_type and _band_id serve different purposes — _row_type describes row semantics (detail/subtotal/spacer/total), _band_id describes row provenance (which band this row belongs to).

title: Decision: JS stitching with batched WHERE IN for band queries
body:
Chose JS-side stitching over SQL UNION ALL for detail band query execution.

Rationale: UNION ALL requires all branches to have the same column set. Detail bands pull from different tables with different schemas — the only way to UNION them would be to project a superset with NULL padding in every branch, which is complex SQL for a SQLite in-browser engine.

JS stitching mirrors the existing runTotalsMode pattern (engine.ts:45-86): run separate queries, combine results in JavaScript. This is simpler, testable, and consistent with the codebase's existing approach.

Batched WHERE IN (instead of per-row queries) keeps the query count manageable: 1 parent query + N band queries (where N = number of detail bands, typically 1-3), not 1 + parent_rows * N.

Amending DD-subreport-detail-rows.md to address 15 gaps found by PatternEnforcer. Key findings:

1. **Barrel exports missing** — `preact/index.ts` doesn't export any new types/functions/components. All four public API surfaces (DetailBandSpec, buildBandQuery/BandQueryResult, DetailBandStage, createDetailBandSpec) need export lines.

2. **ReportSpec construction incomplete** — `run-bar.tsx:68-100` builds a ReportSpec from AppState but omits `detailBands` and `detailBandMode`. Engine never receives band config.

3. **Dependency graph incomplete** — `report-graph.ts:77-81` builds refs from base/stacks/lookups but not `detailBands[].rightId`. Cross-report dependencies via detail bands won't be detected.

6. **alias-ref-updater.ts doesn't propagate renames to detail bands** — `_renameProjectedAliasRefs()` updates filters/sorts/groupBy/aggregates but not `detailBands[].keyPairs[].left` or `detailBands[].cols`.

title: Codebase research for pipeline preview design
body:
Completed codebase research for pipeline preview fix. Key findings:

1. **CONTRACTS.md mismatch confirmed** — Line 424 declares PipelineArrow props as `{ id: string; buildPreviewHTML: (id: string) => string }` but actual code only accepts `{ id: string }`. The contract was never implemented.

2. **Old implementation found** in git at commit 46d15d7: `SRC/js/ui/views/query-builder.tsx` lines 144-207. Two functions: `_buildPreviewSQL(key)` builds a partial spec and calls `buildQueryPlan` + `renderDetailSql`, stripping ORDER BY and appending `LIMIT 5`. `_buildPreviewHTML(key)` executes the SQL, builds an HTML table string via `dangerouslySetInnerHTML`.

3. **Old preview used `colDisplayLabel` (async)** — the new implementation must use sync `colUserLabel` instead.

4. **Old preview had no band support** — `bandN` keys didn't exist in the old code. Band preview is new territory.

5. **Old preview stripped ORDER BY with regex** — `result.sql.replace(/\s*(?:(?<!\()ORDER BY[^;]+)?$/, ' LIMIT 5')`. Fragile but worked. New approach should build SQL without sorts from the start.

6. **execQuery is synchronous** — confirmed at `core/sqldb.ts:95`. Returns `Record<string, unknown>[]`.

7. **buildQueryPlan is pure** — takes `(reportSpec, tables)`, no global state. Perfect for preview.

8. **buildReportSpecFromState** returns `Record<string, unknown>` not `ReportSpec` — needs casting or a proper ReportSpec builder for preview.

9. **Test patterns** — tests use `initStore()` in `beforeEach`, `makeReportSpec()` helper from `tests/query/helpers.ts`, and standard table fixtures.

10. **No existing tests for PipelineArrow** — confirmed. No `pipeline-arrow.test.*` files exist.

title: Codebase research for store-based alias rename propagation
body:
Completed codebase research for store-based alias rename propagation. Key findings:

1. **Store API confirmed**: `getStore().update(draft => { ... })` deep-clones state (preserving Sets), mutates draft, notifies listeners. Located in `preact/core/store.ts`.

2. **All alias-bearing fields verified in types.ts**: filters[].col, sorts[].col, aggregates[].col, groupBy[], subtotalBy[], mergedCols[], detailBands[].keyPairs[].left, detailBands[].sorts[].col, lookups[].keyPairs[].left, calcStages[].compare.conditions[].col, selCols (Set<string>|null), colOrder (string[]|null).

3. **Calc-internal reference structures mapped** (from sql-calcs.ts and calc-validator.ts):
   - math.steps[]: `{ type: 'column', value: '<alias>' }` — value field holds alias
   - compare.conditions[]: `{ col: '<alias>', op, val }` — col field holds alias
   - compare.trueValue/falseValue: `{ type: 'column', value: '<alias>' }` — value field when type='column'
   - text.parts[]: `{ type: 'column', value: '<alias>' }` — value field when type='column'
   - text.source: `{ type: 'column', value: '<alias>' }` — value field when type='column'
   - date.source: `{ type: 'column', value: '<alias>' }` — value field when type='column'

4. **_afterCombineChange() already calls invalidateValidation()** internally (layout-selection.ts:227). It also does its own store.update() to fix selCols/colOrder based on buildColSourceMap(). This means after our rename update, _afterCombineChange() will correctly add the new alias and remove the old from selCols/colOrder.

5. **Three call sites confirmed**:
   - calc-stage.tsx:99-101 — handleAliasChange uses updateCalc (no propagation)
   - rename-modal.tsx:44-55 — handleRename directly mutates draft (no propagation)
   - utils.ts:236-238 — renameProjectedColumn directly mutates draft (no propagation)

6. **Old alias-ref-updater.ts**: Only exists in bundled output (pkg/js/app.bundle.js). Source file already deleted. No legacy coexistence concern.

7. **Design decision**: The pure draft helper should handle selCols/colOrder updates for testability and batch-use, even though _afterCombineChange() also handles them. This makes the helper self-contained. _afterCombineChange() becomes a safety net and handles subtotal sync.

title: Decision: Orchestrator + Pure Draft Helper two-layer design
body:
Chose Orchestrator + Pure Draft Helper two-layer design over alternatives:

**Option A (Single monolithic function)**: Rejected — not testable without store, can't be reused for batch operations.

**Option B (Orchestrator + Pure Helper)**: Selected — the pure draft helper `renameAliasRefsInternal(draft, oldAlias, newAlias)` is testable with plain objects, reusable for batch/multi-alias renames, and has no store dependency. The orchestrator `renameCalcAlias(idx, newAlias)` wraps it with store.update(), reads old alias, calls the helper, then triggers _afterCombineChange().

**Option C (Event-based propagation)**: Rejected — over-engineered for this scope. No subscriber pattern exists in the codebase for this kind of thing. Would add complexity without benefit.

Key rationale: The codebase already uses the pattern of "pure function + store wrapper" (e.g., state-applier.ts wraps store.update with hydration logic). This design follows that convention.

title: v2 band export layout — codebase research findings
body:
v2 export design research complete. Key findings:

1. **Match value propagation is the core challenge**: `padBandRow()` in engine.ts null-pads ALL parent columns on band rows, including the match column (`keyPairs[0].left`). So band rows have `null` for the parent key alias. The v2 layout needs the match value on every row — must be extracted from the preceding parent row during export formatting by tracking `currentMatchValue` as we iterate.

2. **Band column aliases use `_{bandId}_` prefix**: e.g., `_band_0_Product`. The `hdrMap` resolves these via `colExportLabel()` → `colUserLabel(band.rightId, physicalColName)`. Each band has its own set of prefixed columns in the superset.

3. **Different bands can have different column sets AND different match columns**: `keyPairs[0].left` could theoretically differ across bands. The v2 layout (single column 1) requires all bands to share the same match column. This should be a constraint.

4. **Child key columns are selected WITHOUT prefix**: `sql-detail-bands.ts:84` selects child key cols as raw names (e.g., `OrderID`), not with the band prefix. These exist on band rows but are separate from the parent-side match alias.

5. **v1 export pipeline**: `filterExportCols → enrichRowsWithBandHeaders → remap → json_to_sheet → styleExportSheet`. The v2 function replaces the middle steps (enrichRows + remap) with a different row-building strategy.

6. **Row kind 5 needed for parent rows**: In v2, parent rows are visually distinct (only col 1 populated, act as group headers). Recommend new kind 5 with bold text + subtle fill to differentiate from both band data rows (kind 0) and band section headers (kind 4).

7. **Existing test file**: `export-bands.test.ts` has 41 tests covering v1 behavior. All must continue passing. New tests go alongside.

8. **CSV should keep v1 layout**: CSV has no styling/formatting, and the superset-column layout with `_band_id` is the correct machine-readable schema. v2 is an XLSX-only layout mode.

title: Design doc: pivot table UI redesign — key architectural decisions
body:
Writing DD-pivot-table-ui-redesign. Key decisions grounded in codebase research:

1. **Sidebar stays 270px** — matches existing `.sidebar` CSS width (style.css:54). No layout breakage.
2. **Native HTML5 DnD** — extends existing pattern in column-chips.tsx:177-215 (DragEvent, dataTransfer.effectAllowed='move', _chipAtPoint helper). No new library.
3. **Store _ui field** — AppState has no UI-only fields today. Adding `_ui?: { sidebarCollapsed, columnWidths, previewDirty, lastResultHash }` as optional to avoid breaking serialization.
4. **Modal for calc editor** — existing Modal component (modal.tsx) is portal-based, supports escape key, backdrop close. CalcBuilder content stays as-is.
5. **ContextMenu for header right-click** — existing ContextMenu (context-menu.tsx) is portal-based with auto-reposition. Wraps it for header-specific items.
6. **No types.ts changes required** — AppState._ui is optional, no breaking serialization. All existing fields preserved.
7. **export.ts stays untouched** — 496 lines of export logic, called from toolbar Export button.
8. **run-bar.tsx logic absorbed into pivot-toolbar.tsx** — validation pill + run logic become auto-preview trigger.

title: Revised DD-band-export-v2: parent-column-aligned layout replaces compact layout
body:
Revised DD-band-export-v2.md to correct fundamental design error. The previous design used a compact [match + band cols] layout that removed parent column context. The corrected design uses parent-column-aligned layout with relabeling:

Key changes:
1. Sheet header = parent column labels (not [match + band cols])
2. Parent rows pass through with ALL parent columns populated (not collapsed to match value)
3. Band section headers: col 0 = match value, cols 1+ = band display names relabeling parent positions
4. Band data rows: col 0 = empty, cols 1+ = band values in parent positions
5. Sheet width = parent column count P (not 1 + N band cols), with appending for wider bands
6. applyBandGroup() signature changed: allBandLabels → allHeaders (full header array)
7. buildBandColumnLayout() now identifies parent columns by excluding band-prefixed and internal columns

Preserved: composable transformation architecture, _processed flag pattern, row kind system, computeBandColSets(), kind 5 styling, per-band match column resolution, all constraints, open questions.

title: Preact-to-React conversion: codebase research complete
body:
Research for Preact-to-React conversion DD. Key findings:

1. **Store adapter is trivial**: Every component uses identical pattern: `useState(getStore().getState())` + `useEffect(subscribe)`. This maps 1:1 to `useSyncExternalStore`. Custom `useStore()` hook wraps it. No Zustand needed.

2. **AG Grid imperative → declarative**: grid.tsx uses `agGrid.createGrid()` with module-level singletons (`gridResult`, `gridPreview`). Anonymous class-based header components (`_makeHeaderComponent`). Must become `<AgGridReact>` with React functional header components. Double-RAF refresh hacks go away.

3. **Component count**: 25 files total. 7 components, 3 cards, 11 sections, 4 root modules. ~3000+ lines UI code.

4. **Build pipeline**: `npm run dev` = `tsc --watch` (NO HMR). Build = custom esbuild-wasm script. Vite adds HMR + standard React DX. esbuild reconfig is possible but no HMR.

5. **Pivot-table overlap**: DD-pivot-table-ui-redesign plans to DELETE grid.tsx and rewrite all 25 UI files. If React conversion happens first, pivot builds in React+MUI (avoiding double work). If pivot first, new Preact components must be re-converted.

6. **ADR-007 conflict**: Proposes Preact signals — opposite direction. Must be rejected/superseded.

7. **Non-component UI files**: tabs.ts (11 lines), aggregation.ts (222 lines), export.ts, loader.ts — pure logic, zero framework imports. These DON'T need conversion, only import path updates if any.

8. **Vendor globals**: AG Grid, XLSX, sql.js loaded via `<script>` tags in index.html. Unchanged. ag-grid-react wraps the same global.

9. **MUI mapping**: Modal→Dialog, Chip→Chip, ContextMenu→Menu, Tip→Tooltip, buttons→Button, selects→Select, tabs→Tabs, cards→Card/Paper, layout→Box/Stack.

10. **Tests**: 1030 tests across 54 files. Most test domain logic (core/catalog/query/report), not UI rendering. Should pass unchanged. Vitest config may need `environment: 'jsdom'` + React setup.

title: Detail Bands Rendering Overlay — Design synthesis from Ideator + Architect + AG Grid research
body:
Synthesized findings from RnD-Ideator (3 approaches), RnD-Architect (3 options with tradeoff matrix), and Support-Researcher (AG Grid Community capabilities).

Key decisions:
1. Selected Hybrid approach (Architect's Option C / Ideator's Approach 2): Engine returns flat parent rows + separate band result sets. Shared grouping layer produces OverlayDescriptors. Consumers (grid, export) use descriptors for rendering.
2. AG Grid Community v32.1.0 supports full-width rows (isFullWidthRow + fullWidthCellRenderer) for band section headers. Master/detail, tree data, row grouping are Enterprise-only — not viable.
3. Band data rows must remain pre-stitched into a unified column set for AG Grid Community. Cannot have per-row column sets without Enterprise.
4. The overlay model must coordinate with export label resolution (hdrMap prefix stripping) to avoid raw internal aliases leaking to headers.
5. Match value must come from preceding parent row — padBandRow() nulls ALL parent columns including match column. This invariant is preserved in the overlay model.

Rejected approaches:
- Overlay Node Tree (Ideator Approach 3): Cleanest architecture but highest migration cost. Not justified for current band maturity.
- Clean Separation (Architect Option B): Each consumer independently groups — duplicates grouping logic, risks inconsistency.
- Keep interleaving unchanged (Architect Option A): Doesn't solve the fundamental data/rendering conflation.

Ripple effects: engine.ts (return type), result-set.ts (new metadata), new report/overlay-grouping.ts module, grid.tsx (full-width rows), export.ts (replace applyBandGroup/buildBandColumnLayout with descriptor consumer), validation.ts (new rules for match column existence vs selCols membership).

title: AG Grid Community v32.1.0 full-width row capabilities for band overlays
body:
AG Grid Community v32.1.0 (loaded as global script bundle in index.html) supports:
- isFullWidthRow callback + fullWidthCellRenderer for custom full-width section headers ✅
- embedFullWidthRows for horizontal scroll sync ✅
- applyTransaction for programmatic row insertion ✅
- getRowStyle for per-row tinting ✅
- cellRendererSelector for per-row cell rendering ✅

NOT available in Community (Enterprise-only):
- Master/detail (isRowMaster + detailCellRenderer) ❌
- Tree data (getDataPath) ❌
- Row grouping (rowGroup on column defs) ❌

Implication: Band section headers can use full-width rows. Band data rows must share the unified column set. Pre-stitching is unavoidable for band data in AG Grid Community.

title: Design doc created: DD-detail-bands-rendering-overlay.md — Hybrid Overlay Descriptors selected
body:
Design document created at artifacts/designs/pending/DD-detail-bands-rendering-overlay.md.

Selected approach: Hybrid Overlay Descriptors (Option C).

Key architectural decisions:
1. Engine returns BandResultSet (flat parent rows + separate band results) instead of interleaved rows
2. New overlay-grouping.ts module in Report layer produces OverlayDescriptor[] from BandResultSet
3. OverlayDescriptor is a union type: parent | band-section | band-row
4. Grid uses AG Grid Community full-width rows (isFullWidthRow + fullWidthCellRenderer) for band section headers
5. Band data rows remain pre-stitched into unified column set for AG Grid (Enterprise features not available)
6. Export consumes descriptors directly, replacing applyBandGroup() / buildBandColumnLayout()
7. Null-padding moves from engine to grid adapter — rendering concern, not data concern
8. Group boundaries detected by match key transitions in parent data, not _band_id transitions in interleaved data
9. Match columns don't need to be in selCols — they're used for grouping, not display

Four-phase migration path:
- Phase 1: Grouping layer + flat engine output (with compatibility adapter)
- Phase 2: Grid overlay rendering (full-width section headers)
- Phase 3: Export overlay rendering (replace applyBandGroup/buildBandColumnLayout)
- Phase 4: Nested bands + hidden match columns

title: Design doc created: Temp-Table Pipeline Architecture
body: Created DD-temp-table-pipeline.md — replaces compiled-query approach with SQLite temp table pipeline. Key decisions: (1) Stage functions are pure Report-layer modules that create/transform temp tables sequentially, (2) Temp tables use _pipeline_ prefix with quoteId(), (3) Detail bands remain separate in v1 (not integrated into pipeline), (4) Column catalog retained for resolution during construction, (5) Preview simplified to SELECT from temp table, (6) Validation stays colMap-based in v1, migrated to temp table schemas later, (7) PipelineState is module-level (not serialized). The design fixes the critical stacks bug (stacks ignored in all four SQL generators), eliminates preview duplication, and reduces maintenance from four SQL generators to independent stage functions. Open questions around pipeline invalidation strategy, totals mode result combination, and memory management — all deferred to implementation.

title: DD-temp-table-pipeline rewritten: full feature, no v1/v2, all decisions resolved
body:
Rewrote DD-temp-table-pipeline.md from scratch. Previous version was rejected for deferring too much to "v2" and containing a technical bug (ALTER TABLE + UPDATE for source column using _rowno, which is unreliable because SQLite doesn't guarantee UNION ALL row ordering in temp tables).

Key changes from previous version:
1. Removed all v1/v2 phasing — full feature in one DD
2. Resolved all open questions as decided (no open questions remain)
3. Fixed source column approach: literal in SELECT clause of each UNION ALL branch, not ALTER TABLE + UPDATE
4. Fixed totals mode: single temp table with _row_type marker (like subtotals), not two tables combined in JS
5. Detail bands: explicitly excluded from pipeline refactoring, read from pipeline's final output table
6. Pipeline invalidation: simple downstream invalidation on any state change
7. Migration strategy: 4 phases within single commit (foundation → integration → delete old code → UI)
8. buildQueryPlan: refactored to config-builder, not deleted

Research covered: engine.ts (all mode dispatchers), query-plan.ts (full orchestrator), preview-builder.ts (365 lines of duplication), all four SQL generators (confirmed stacks bug), column-catalog.ts (two APIs), validation.ts (colMap-based prediction), types.ts (AppState/ReportSpec), state-serializer/hydrator, sql-detail-bands.ts, result-set.ts.

The DD is grounded in real code — every method referenced exists, every layer placement follows conventions, every pattern proposed is one the project already uses.

title: Design doc created: DD-dd-live-chip-table-ui
body:
Created DD-dd-live-chip-table-ui.md — comprehensive design for single-screen pivot layout on React+MUI+AG Grid React stack.

Key decisions:
1. AG Grid React stays (no custom grid) — drop zones implemented as dynamic overlays (React portals)
2. HTML5 DnD for palette→grid, AG Grid native for column reorder (two systems with clear boundary)
3. 3-zone drop detection: top 30% = agg key, middle 50% = add/reorder, bottom 20% = band
4. Auto-preview: 400ms debounce + hash dirty check via JSON.stringify(buildReportSpecFromState())
5. _ui field in AppState for UI-only state (column widths, sidebar collapsed, preview dirty)
6. MUI Collapse for pipeline sections (28px slim headers vs 48px Accordion)
7. ag-theme-balham-dark + CSS variable overrides for MUI dark theme alignment

Architecture:
- PivotLayout → PivotSidebar (270px) + PivotMain (flex: 1)
- PivotSidebar → ColumnPalette + PipelineStages (Base, Stacks, Lookups, Calcs, Detail Bands)
- PivotMain → PivotToolbar + PivotGrid (<AgGridReact> + DropZoneOverlay)

Implementation: 8 phases, 29 hours estimated, ~13 source files + ~6 test files
Risk: Drop zone overlay (Phase 3) is highest-risk — dynamic portal, AG Grid header measurement, 3-zone detection

Supersedes:
- DD-pivot-table-ui-redesign.md (Preact version, 768 lines) — OBSOLETE, specified custom grid deleting AG Grid
- DD-pivot-table-ui-redesign-react.md (56-line stub) — OBSOLETE, said DELETE grid.tsx (WRONG)
